BETA Close X CRH plc announced that on April 6, 2026, it purchased 30,734 of its ordinary shares in the United States through its broker, Wells Fargo Securities, LLC, as part of its share buyback program. The total value of these repurchased shares was approximately $3.22 million, with an average price of $104.8822 per share. These repurchased shares will be cancelled, and following this transaction, CRH plc will have 668,266,879 ordinary shares in issue, excluding treasury shares. Disclaimer* 7 th April 2026 CRH plc Transaction in Own Shares CRH plc (“ CRH ”) announces that on 6 th April 2026 it acquired the following number of its ordinary shares (the “ ordinary shares ”) in the United States through CRH’s broker Wells Fargo Securities, LLC. The ordinary shares acquired (by way of redemption) will be cancelled. Following settlement of the above transactions and subsequent share cancellation CRH will have 668,266,879 ordinary shares in issue (excluding treasury shares). CRH will also hold 35,634,977 of its ordinary shares in treasury, which represents 5.062% of the issued ordinary share capital of CRH. Ordinary shares held in treasury do not have any voting rights.
